visualCharacteristics.purpose: Top-of-page hero with a photographic background and calls to action
visualCharacteristics.description: Full-width banner with a background photo, H1, intro text and primary/secondary CTAs
visualCharacteristics.source: Full-width photo background with H1, intro and two CTAs; photo background belongs to the hero, so the section is not colored.

contentPattern.structure: Row 1: background image. Row 2: H1 title, intro paragraph, CTA links (first link is primary, others secondary)
rows: H1 title, intro paragraph, CTA links (primary: Explore Industries, secondary: Become a Partner)

reuseGuidance: Use for the single page-opening banner; for heroes without a background photo use the base hero block.
